name: introduction/hello
description: ADR-0015 flight 1: the dialer's hello — versions, the imported target root, the dialer's own claimed root, and a 32-byte base64url nonce. No keys, no card. The wire encoding pins the field set and order (protocol_version, token_version, target_root, claimed_root, nonce); the roots are the RFC 7638 thumbprints of the proof-dialer/-responder agent-card keys.
